diff: +For an activation crossing Product boundaries, the packet applies
+[PRODUCT_DEFINITION PC-03–PC-05](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#pc-03--the-edges-contract-and-authority-record):
+its selected relation and grants, eligible sources/derivations, actual exposure,
+material basis and continuation obligations remain explicit. Permission and
+adequacy are separate predicates; an insufficient permitted view returns its
+missing condition instead of acquiring prohibited material. Byte deduplication
+or recursion must not merge distinct route permissions (P1, P3, P6).
+Capability composition, including recursive and shared constituents, applies
+[PRODUCT_DEFINITION §9](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#product-composition-contract).
+Select the outcome-owning frame and the actual dependency-ready work; retain
+path-specific authority and material far-side reliance. A cycle in Product
+relations is not itself a work deadlock, and naming a lead supplies no missing
+current prerequisite. An enclosing Product is not required for a constituent's
+scoped standalone entry when its declared dependencies suffice (P3, P6).
-them, with the carriers that hold them, as refs of one release source.
